data.name: Kanusha
data.gender_notes: Kanusha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kanusha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kanu’ which means ‘Krishna’ and ‘Sha’ which means ‘treasure’. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to symbolize the presence of God Krishna and the idea of wealth and abundance in their lives. The name Kanusha carries the meaning “Goddess of Treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanusha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine grace and abundance.
data.etymology: Kanusha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanusha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Kanusha is a beautiful name that is deeply rooted in Hindu tradition and culture. It is a name that evokes a sense of reverence and respect towards God Krishna. In Hindu society, children are often given names with religious significance to instill a deep sense of spiritual values and beliefs within them from an early age. The name Kanusha reflects this tradition as it is a constant reminder of the presence of God Krishna and the blessings that he bestows upon his devotees.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kanusha holds great spiritual significance in Hinduism as it is believed to bring the blessings of Lord Krishna upon the child bearing this name. Krishna is considered one of the most beloved deities in Hinduism and is known for his infinite love, wisdom, and power. The name Kanusha signifies the presence of Krishna as a guardian, guide, and source of spiritual wealth and abundance. It is believed that the name imparts blessings of peace, harmony, and prosperity in the lives of those who carry it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kanusha: Dedicated to Lord Vishnu, symbolizing pure devotion and selfless service, with a heart full of compassion and wisdom.

The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
